name: Terraforming Mars

categories.label: Terraform rating
categories.help: Your rating on the track when the game ends.

categories.label: Milestones
categories.help: Number of milestones you claimed (5 points each).

categories.label: Awards
categories.help: Awards: 5 points for first, 2 for second (no second place in a 2-player game; a tie for first has no second place).

categories.label: Greenery tiles
categories.help: One point per greenery tile you own.

categories.label: Cities
categories.help: One point for each greenery next to each of your cities.

categories.label: Card points
categories.help: Victory points on your played cards, including any that are negative.

categories.label: Megacredits
categories.help: Megacredits in hand; the most wins a tie.

notes: Base game; Prelude and other expansions are out of scope. Solo play has a different goal (complete terraforming within 14 generations) and is not modelled as a score contest.
